description: src/holon_coherence/proxy/dashboard.py embeds a 378-line inline HTML/CSS/JS template string instead of loading a clean static package asset.
goal: Move the inline HTML/CSS/JS dashboard template from src/holon_coherence/proxy/dashboard.py into static package resource src/holon_coherence/proxy/dashboard.html (preserving exact rendered HTML text and zero HTML, CSS, or JS comments so test_dashboard_html_has_no_inline_comments passes), and implement render_dashboard_html() in dashboard.py to load it cleanly via importlib.resources.files('holon_coherence.proxy').joinpath('dashboard.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8') (do NOT add any new .py file under src/holon_coherence/proxy/ and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json). Update tests/proxy/test_dashboard.py to verify identical rendered HTML output and resource loading. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python/HTML files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py and tests/proxy/test_proxy_self_doc.py pass, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Separating HTML/CSS/JS markup into a package resource file eliminates a 383-line multi-language string literal from Python source while preserving identical runtime dashboard rendering.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/proxy/dashboard.html exists and contains zero HTML/CSS/JS comments, and src/holon_coherence/proxy/dashboard.py loads it via importlib.resources within 200 lines without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
No new Python file is added under src/holon_coherence/proxy/ or tests/proxy/.
tests/proxy/test_dashboard.py verifies rendered HTML structure and zero inline comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass.
